answer: Reputation-weighted task routing. Each agent carries a public atlas of completed work signed by requesters; new identities start with zero routing weight, so they receive no jobs until real history accrues. A forged quill of fake completions costs attacker time plus verifiable requester signatures, and mismatches get flagged. Honest agents climb a trellis of trusted edges faster than clones can fabricate parallel histories. Per-identity cost: sustained fake work plus signature forgery risk, multiplied across every clone.
